title: Reaction
description: A single reactor's answer to an open attack/card transaction, submitted with `sim.py react --game N --seat S --file F` (simulation.md §5.3). Valid only while phase == 'react' and the seat is listed in `pending`.

action.description: take: the defender takes the blow. defend: defender plays Defense card(s). pass: does nothing. intervene: any other player adds an Intervention/defense-as-intervention/'as an Intervention' card. respond: answer to a group card.

cards.description: Uids from the reactor's own hand; also 'trap' to name their own table trap (Bell, Iyo swaps). Named cards leave the hand into transit at once.

trap.description: Defender only: whether to also trigger their own trap alongside a defend. Ignored when the attack is thrown or the trap cannot fire.

when.description: Conditional interventions (A2): when this reaction should apply.

target.description: Seat, for interventions that need one (Dragon Strike, Ginger, Block for whom).

choice.description: Free text for group cards ('I discard the Parry', 'I hand him my Tanto').

consent.description: Willingness flags read by the referee (Ketsuban, Oath, Feat of Valor).
